items.prompt: A parser uses int(3.9). What value is produced in Python?

options.text: An exception because no float can become int
options.why: Finite floats can be converted, with truncation.
int does not round to the nearest whole number.
A successful int call returns an integer.
That may violate a precision contract if used silently.

items.explanation: int(3.9) produces 3 by truncation toward zero. A numeric conversion is not automatically a valid domain-specific rounding policy.
